output.source_text: The Half-Whole Diminished Scale is a symmetric 8-note (octatonic) scale constructed by alternating half steps (1 semitone) and whole steps (2 semitones).

note_vi: Bài 22 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 02:10-02:55. The Half-Whole Diminished Scale is a symmetric 8-note (octatonic) scale constructed by alternating half steps (1 semitone) and whole steps (2 semitones).
